description: Major video-game publisher (EA Sports FC, Madden, Battlefield, The Sims) taken private on 2026-08-04 in a $55B all-cash buyout — the largest LBO on record — by Saudi Arabia's PIF (~93.4%), Silver Lake and Jared Kushner's Affinity Partners, at $210/share with ~$20B of JPMorgan-arranged debt.

Strategic partnership between the US Government and Westinghouse's owners Brookfield (51%) and Cameco (49%) to deploy at least $80B of new AP1000/AP300 reactors in the US, with the government arranging financing and permitting in exchange for 20% of Westinghouse cash distributions above $17.5B plus an IPO warrant.

target: NAVER GAK Sejong AI factory (Korea national AI factory)
description: Sovereign AI factory buildout at NAVER's GAK Sejong hyperscale data center in South Korea, expanding an NVIDIA DSX deployment from 55MW to 200MW by 2028 (with a 1GW ambition); Brookfield is funding up to $9B, NVIDIA investing $1B in NAVER, and NAVER covering the remainder.

target: Williams Power Innovation JV (Socrates, Apollo, Aquila, Socrates the Younger, Neo)
description: Joint venture holding five Williams Companies behind-the-meter power projects (Socrates, Apollo, Aquila, Socrates the Younger, Neo) serving AI/data-center demand; Blackstone Credit & Insurance with Apollo and KKR insurance vehicles committed $5.34B for a 49% noncontrolling stake, with Williams retaining 51% and operational control.

North American clean-power arm of French utility EDF (formerly EDF Renewables North America), a top-ten US renewable-energy owner with wind, solar and battery-storage assets built over ~40 years; KKR agreed on 2026-06-30 to acquire the business for $4.2B plus up to $390M in earnouts, its largest renewables deal.

400+MW hyperscale data center in Kemps Creek, Western Sydney, operated by Blackstone-owned AirTrunk — billed as Asia-Pacific's largest by capacity and the first phase of a larger campus; Blackstone finalized a ~A$4.3B (US$3B) five-year syndicated construction loan for the project in July 2026.

Industrial-robotics division of Swiss engineering group ABB, one of the world's largest industrial robot makers, being acquired by SoftBank Group for $5.4B (announced October 2025, closing expected mid-to-late 2026) as part of SoftBank's AI-plus-robotics push; banks wrapped a $1.75B-equivalent acquisition loan in July 2026.

US luxury electric-vehicle maker (Air sedan, Gravity SUV) majority-owned by Saudi Arabia's PIF; on 2026-07-06 it drew $800M from delayed-draw term loan facilities provided by PIF affiliate Ayar Third Investment, its second 2026 draw, lifting pro-forma liquidity to about $4.7B after a Q2 delivery miss.

target: Coatue Growth Fund VI Private Investors Cayman, L.P.
description: Cayman-domiciled feeder vehicle for Coatue Growth Fund VI, Coatue Management's sixth growth-stage fund targeting late-stage technology and AI companies; a Form D filed 2026-07-15 reported roughly $527M raised into this offshore vehicle (a parallel US feeder reported ~$778M).

New York legal-AI company building regulatory and legal AI agents, plus an AI-native law firm (Norm Law) where human attorneys supervise its agents on outcome-based pricing; raised a $120M Series C led by Khosla Ventures at a $1.2B valuation in July 2026, with Blackstone, Bain Capital Ventures and Coatue participating.

"Agentic Software Control" security company founded by SentinelOne, Wiz and Palo Alto Networks veterans, giving SecOps teams inventory, posture and policy control over AI agents, AI-enabled apps, browsers and identities; emerged from stealth in July 2026 with $100M from Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer, plus Craft and Merlin Ventures.

All-in-one TypeScript backend platform (database, functions, real-time sync, workflow) founded in 2021 by ex-Dropbox infrastructure engineers, now positioned as the reliable backend for AI-agent-written software; raised a $57M Series B led by Insight Partners with a16z, Spark Capital and Justin Kan participating, bringing total funding to $110.5M.

Nasdaq-listed semiconductor company (ALMU) in Goleta, California developing photonic and electronic chips on large-diameter substrates for AI interconnects, mobile, defense and quantum; signed a CHIPS R&D Office letter of intent with the Commerce Department in July 2026 for up to $30M to develop indium-phosphide-free photodetector and laser technology.

US neocloud company established July 2026 by SoftBank Corp. (51%) and SoftBank Group (49%) to rent GPU cloud capacity to American enterprises and hyperscalers from fiscal 2027, scaling toward 10GW of AI data-center capacity and building on SoftBank's Japanese GPU cloud and Infrinia AI Cloud OS stack.

Portland, Oregon company (founded 2016) building autonomous wave-powered floating platforms that generate ocean energy and run onboard AI inference compute with seawater cooling; raised a $140M Series B led by Peter Thiel at a reported ~$1B valuation to build its Oregon pilot plant for Ocean-3 series nodes, with commercial systems planned for 2027.

Clinical-stage biotech (Cambridge, MA; founded by Greg Verdine) that mines fungal genomes for drug candidates via its "Top-Down Drug Discovery" platform; raised $263M (a $188M Series E plus $75M Series D) in August 2026 from Bezos Expeditions, Gates Frontier and RA Capital to advance LIFE-001, a novel calcineurin-activation inhibitor for preventing organ-transplant rejection.

Cambridge (UK)-based AI-for-materials-discovery company whose generative search engine predicts viable molecular and chemical structures, used by ASML, Meta, Samsung and Hyundai; raised a $450M Series B at a $2.6B valuation in July 2026 led by Kleiner Perkins and NEA, with Bezos Expeditions among new investors — up from a $520M valuation nine months earlier.

Delaware venture-capital vehicle formed in 2026 by Brad Gerstner's Altimeter Capital (Boston), which filed a Form D on 2026-07-28 for a $40M offering ($2M minimum, no sales yet at filing). The specific underlying investment behind the "Kilauea" vehicle is not disclosed in the filing.
